titulo: Info Matrix (Textos 05) — Cap. 5 — Meltlilith e BB

linhas.en:
A simple combat style.
The result of Meltlilith's adoration of classical ballet,
retuning herself with various attack skills.
She obtained diverse powers by converting the origins
of already completed stories and stages into skills.

There are many references. The explanations are as follows.

"The Heel Named Curse Blade Giselle"
From the classical ballet "Giselle"
Despairing from betrayal by her beloved Albrecht, Giselle
uses his sword in a frenzied dance, during which she dies.
Women who die before marriage become ghosts known as wilis.
She became a wilis, who abduct and dance men to death, but…

"Unforgivable Hilarion"
From the classical ballet "Giselle"
Hilarion, who deceived Giselle, is caught by the Wilis and
pays for his crime. He is not forgiven, and without waiting
for dawn, they make him dance until he dies from exhaustion.

"Farewell, Albrecht"
From the classical ballet "Giselle"
Albrecht is caught by the wilis, but his life is spared
when he's saved by one of them. As Albrecht,
spared from death by exhaustion, raises his face,
the form of the girl he loved most fades like an illusion.

"The Siren Lights a Fire Inside"
From the classical ballet "The Prodigal Son"
A rural lord's son runs away for a life in the city.
Many temptations lurk in the city, the most extreme
being the enchantress Siren, who corrupts men
with the wiles she's gained from a life of adversity.

             ◆

However, the lineage of these skills are mere distractions.
Crime Ballet refers to how Meltlilith has been cheating.

To make herself invincible, Meltlilith rewrote a basic rule
on the Far Side of the Moon, "the lack of a sense of time"
with "the lack of hit detection on Meltlilith."

Instead of training herself thoroughly, Meltlilith's act
of altering the rules of the world to grant herself
a privilege out of selfishness is itself a criminal act.

Alter Egos are High Servants created as
a composite amalgamation of Heroic Spirits.

BB accessed the Moon Cell's Servant Archives, chose
goddesses compatible with each Ego, and reproduced the data.
Alter Egos came into existence as composite goddesses.

Meltlilith is made up of three goddesses.


The first is the chaste goddess Artemis of Greek mythology.
Linked with the tides, and thus the moon's movements,
she would take aim with mana to shoot unfailingly,
and at the same time, bring plague and death.

The second is the crossed snake staff originating from
either Old Testament's Leviathan or Ugaritic myths' Lotan.
It has the same origin as the staff Moses used to split
the Red Sea, also acting as a symbol of the split sea.
Allows its holder to change properties like water, making
them adaptable to any situation. They may also freely
change their form, even to the shape of the holder's envy.

The third is the Hindu river goddess, Saraswati.
She holds the ability to control "things that flow"
like water & wind, music & words, speech, poetry & prose
and such natural phenomena. The flow of her timbre can
excite any emotion from the hearts of those who hear it,
and moreover, interfere with the flow of electricity
in a computer network.
キーワード２偽名テキスト

The Noble Phantasm that BB granted this Alter Ego.

Originally, it was not an Anti-Unit but an Anti-Populace,
Anti-World Noble Phantasm. Not something to be used
in combat or on a warrior, but against something in
the range of a civilization with an established culture.

Meltlilith's sweet honey melts not only the body,
but even the spirit. This Noble Phantasm dissolves the
good sense and morals of a community, shaping it into
a single body resembling a colony.

Trampling on the bodies, hearts, societies that have
turned to slime, she absorbs the power they had.

That it shows such effectiveness against non-combatants
is due to Meltlilith's depravity leaking out.

             ◆

The one used as a basis was one of the Seven Lucky Gods,
a goddess like the Three Goddesses of Munakata and Ugajin;
Benzaiten.

It is the biwa of Benzaiten who controls "things that flow"
like water & wind, music & words, speech, poetry & prose
and such natural phenomena, given form as a Noble Phantasm.
Benzaiten's origin is the Hindu river goddess, Saraswati.
Born of the creation god Brahma, but was unable to stand
his passionate gaze, who desired her as his consort due to
her overwhelming beauty, so she desperately ran from him,
making her a goddess that's timid in the face of love.
Saraswati is a goddess presiding over art and education,
and when she came to be worshiped as Benzaiten,
she gained the ability to increase property as well.
宝具・偽名のテキストを記述します。

A skill that gives modifiers to one's aggression in battle.
It sounds like a favorable skill, but the longer its holder
stays in battle, the more their sadism grows, causing them
to lose their normal composure. You could say it's just
one step short of the skill that makes Berserkers rampage.

The more they attack, the stronger they become,
but on the other hand, their defensive abilities drop.
With the added disadvantage of unconsciously lowering
their chances of escape, you could say this skill has
bad compatibility with the usually-composed Meltlilith.
スキル１偽名テキスト

A special ability, called id_es,
that Alter Egos possess since their creation.

A cheat skill that evolved from "Absorption."
The highest rank of energy drain.
Draining, copying, and scaling down are all possible.

The drain process has two parts. 
First, the virus #ROFS0003#RUBS poison#RUBEhoney#REND produced in Meltlilith's body 
is injected into the target and fuses the parameters 
to be stolen: [experience], [skills], [capacity], etc. 
Then she absorbs, converts, and unifies with the parameters
liquified by the virus.

As long as it has form, it can be drained, regardless of
whether it's organic or not, but things without form……
things like spiritual nature and skills can be fused,
but making them "her own" is difficult, so she can only
use them as simple nutrients.

For this reason, what Meltlilith primarily makes "her own"
is mainly "experience" and "capacity."

             ◆

With this ability, Meltlilith planned to augment
"her own transcription." She created a transferable virus
capable of melting the entire contents of an digital frame
and transfigure them into herself…… Meltlilith.
スキル２偽名テキスト

The Riding ability.
As long as it's an existing animal, even if it is a wild,
it can be ridden. Usually, only knight Servants
such as Saber or Rider would have this skill but……

Why Meltlilith has this skill
should be left to the imagination.
スキル３偽名テキスト

Neurological Disorder:
Humans have 5 senses―sight, sound, smell, taste & touch,
and use those five sensors to understand the outside world,
and as a result, comprehend their own state of being.

Humans fundamentally use these passive senses to interact
with the world. Unconsciously using the excellent sensors
known as the five senses, they take in the ordinary.

However, if any of the five senses degrade,
the consciousness must actively face the outside world.
That which was passive becomes active.

For example, someone who lost their sight will deliberately
specialize in their remaining four senses for use as even
greater sensors. Ironically, their perception will get
several times better than someone who has all five senses.

             ◆

As for Meltlilith's 5 senses, her touch has deteriorated.
Especially her hands―――she's nearly lost all sensation
in her fingers, so she's become quite proactive in
her relationship with the outside world.

It's thought that even her sadistic tendencies
ultimately arose "because I'm the only one who can't
feel the existence of other people."

On a side note, because her fingers are so clumsy,
in spite her hobby of collecting figures,
she can't immerse herself in assembling garage kits.
Currently accepting applications for a skilled assembler!
設定１偽名テキスト

The End of Pleasure:
An Ego born from BB's "Desire to Serve" and "Pleasure."
The kind of abnormally precious girl that men can't help
but want to protect―――was the case, but because her skill
lets her continuously steal her opponent's abilities,
she currently holds an aggressive disposition.

             ◆

In spite of how she takes in others,
she doesn't care to understand or sympathize with them
because Meltlilith can't understand the feelings of others.

She doesn't need other people.
She doesn't understand dreams or love.
In a situation where she acquired "love," she would
probably dedicate everything to attend to the target of it.

To the self-sufficient Meltlilith, their feelings
aren't worth considering. She would declare in
an oppressive manner that what she feels is correct.

With no intention of conversing with them
(oh, I love you more than enough to need that),
with no desire to touch them
(oh, that degree of pleasure is unsatisfactory),
with no mind to say she wants them to love her.
(oh, mutual understanding and such is unnecessary)

Truly, what a domineering Ego devoted to 'no's and 'not's.
Beneath the constant condescension and oppressive attitude, 
there's not a speck of doubt or hesitation in her,
only a genuine "awakening to love."

             ◆

Meltlilith hasn't noticed.
That her true foundation is one who doesn't need others,
an incarnation of "self-pleasure."

What lies at the core of Meltlilith is
"devotion to the one she's fallen in love with."

She repeatedly used Drain to raise her level
and decided to take over the Moon Cell
so she could offer supreme pleasure to her loved one.

Protect her loved one → take them into herself →
within her, (even if she changes to the point she doesn't
know herself anymore) they'll continue to live on forever.
She's determined that this is the highest form of love
she can offer to her loved one.

From Meltlilith's perspective, even BB and Lip
are just "foreign bodies that I feel I have to save."

             ◆

……however, those feelings are too closed off.
For her, whose only certainty was her own feelings,
whose connection with the outside world was insufficient,
"loving someone else" was itself a fatal #RUBS   bug#RUBEerror#REND.
